newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer to address bankers' forum on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer to address bankers' forum on Tuesday.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer will be delivering a speech to bankers on Tuesday at 1700 GMT in Frankfurt.
Tietmeyer is scheduled to address the Association of Representatives of Foreign Banks in Germany.

Separately Bundesbank directorate member Edgar Meister is scheduled to speak at an investor conference organised by the German savings banks in Mainz at 1310 GMT. His speech will focus on Europe's planned monetary union.
